description: Get an llms.txt index for any link: title, one-line summary, and sections of the most useful links with short descriptions. Defaults to the site’s own llms.txt when available. Use native:false to generate a draft for check_llms_txt. Source and cache metadata are in structuredContent.

crawl.description: A channel or profile only: how many of its newest items are opened and described (0–10). Defaults: YouTube 5, GitHub 5, Instagram 4, TikTok 4, X 5. Another depth is cached apart and, when built, counts as ceil(crawl ÷ default) new links (at least 1). Other links ignore it.

fresh.description: Bypass the 24h cache. A rolling 60-second cooldown per caller and normalized URL is shared by both Reader tools, regardless of native. Ordinary cached reads still work.

native.description: Prefer a published llms.txt. Set false to generate instead: content[0].text is the exact sanitized file and any warning is in a separate block. Does not bypass the cache.

url.description: Any public http(s) link, e.g. "docs.stripe.com/payments", "github.com/honojs/hono", a PDF or a video URL. The scheme is optional.

name: llms_txt

source.description: `native` = published by the site; `generated` = made by llms.ink.

warnings.description: Sanitization notices: no removed text or source-controlled carrier labels.

title: llms.txt for a link
